summary: Independent verification of reminders & calendar w/ mode + offsets, scheduler, chat intercept. 12/12 pytest backend tests passed (CRUD + offsets math + legacy fallback + invalid-mode fallback + event↔reminder bi-directional link + calendar listing dedup + chat-mode fires persona message w/ CTA + call-mode goes ringing + legacy no-alerts fires + >6h-late marked missed). Frontend: /reminders form shows remind-options with all 4 offset chips (30 default pressed) + mode call/chat + persona select; create flow produced correct remind-summary 'chat · 30 menit, 1 jam sebelum' + rem-status 'terjadwal'; delete removed it. /calendar EventForm with reminder toggle reveals compact RemindOptions, event-save produced linked reminder visible on /reminders with 'Dari kalender' badge; deleting event removed the linked reminder. Chat with Nadia: 'Catat ya: rapat dengan Budi besok jam 10 pagi, ingatkan 1 jam sebelum lewat chat' returned 📅 'Tercatat di kalender' card and msg-cta 'Buka Kalender' which navigated to /calendar where the event was visible. No console errors on /reminders or /calendar. LLM follow-up ('Ingatkan saya minggu depan ... telepon saja' → calendar_question → 'Selasa jam 9 pagi' → calendar_event) was NOT re-run via UI to save credits — main agent's manual_calendar_followup.py already covers it and the backend intercept path is tested by the chat UI test above.
critical_code_review_comments: Reminders.jsx line 68: `offsets: r.offsets || [r.remind_minutes]` — if a legacy reminder has neither offsets nor remind_minutes (shouldn't happen but defensive), the summary becomes '[undefined] sebelum'. Low risk; consider filtering falsy entries.
Calendar.jsx line 108: `KIND[it.kind].color` will crash if backend ever returns an unknown kind. Add fallback (`KIND[it.kind] || KIND.event`).
RemindOptions.jsx: 1440-minute chip shows '1 hari' but offsetLabel renders it as '1 hari' too — consistent. No issues.
reminders.py scheduler_tick on legacy records: works but silently coerces to a single 30-min alert. Fine as a one-shot migration path; consider logging a one-time info.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (reminders CRUD + calendar event+reminder link + chat 📅 CTA)
